  "edition_title": "Keen Africa Opportunities Digest — July 2026 Edition",

      "body_md": "Chevening is the gold standard of international scholarships. You must apply to three eligible UK universities as part of the process, though you do not need an offer before submitting.\n\nThe competition is intense: fewer than 1% of Nigerian applicants were selected in the 2024–2025 cycle. Winners are not the smartest in the room — they are the most prepared, with concrete leadership stories and a credible post-study plan tied to Nigeria's development. Start your essays, shortlist three UK programmes, and take your IELTS test now. Do not wait until August."
